text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The summer training camp season has 
arrived once again this year.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Phew! We're finally here! Aaah... the 
fresh air out here tastes delicious!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"This really is a nice place. Spacious, 
refreshing, and so comfortable."

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
We're rooming together this year, right! 
Let's have a great year, CB-chan!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
So that's what happened. Yeah, I look 
forward to working with you too!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I was wondering if that tanuki nest 
I found last year was still there. There 
were babies too, and they were so cute.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Totally rad~! You know about that stuff? 
As expected of CB-chan!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, you're in surprisingly high spirits 
today, Maruzen.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Geez, I'm just tickled pink to room 
together! Come on, it'll be a total bummer 
if we get caught! Let's skedaddle!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Before anyone could stop them, the two 
happily ran off to search for a tanuki 
den...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
All in all, and so the summer training 
camp began.
